questions.text: «What is he like?» nima haqida so'raydi?

questions.explanation: Vaqt bog'lovchisidan keyin WILL ishlatilmaydi — Present Simple.

questions.text: «I like coffee» ga rozilik bildirish uchun nima deymiz?
questions.explanation: «I like...» → So do I; «I'm...» → So am I; «I can't...» → Neither can I.

questions.explanation: Inkor rozilik: Neither/Nor + yordamchi + I.
What (a/an) + sifat + OT! ↔ How + sifat/ravish! (How beautiful!).

questions.explanation: Bir konkret holatdagi muvaffaqiyat — was able to / managed to.

questions.text: «Would you mind...?» ga rozilik qanday bildiriladi?
questions.explanation: «Mind» — «e'tiroz qilmoq» ma'nosida, shuning uchun rozilik «No».

options: Would you mind < Could you < Can you
Can you < Could you < Would you mind
Could you < Can you < Would you mind
questions.explanation: Can you (oddiy) → Could you (muloyim) → Would you mind + -ing (eng muloyim).

questions.text: «Do you mind if I...?» ga ruxsat qanday beriladi?
questions.explanation: Bu yerda ham rozilik «No» bilan boshlanadi.
